name: QAR context60 history forecast protocol
main_score: score = 100 / (1 + dataset_level_loss), then average across datasets

aggregation.anchor_level: compute MAE/MSE/RMSE/loss from pred.npy and true.npy
aggregation.dataset_level: mean over four anchors: predict_2_3, predict_4_5, predict_5_6, predict_8_9

univariate_fix.method: forecast each feature as one-channel, stitch feature predictions in index order into (N, pred_len, C), then compute MAE/RMSE/loss once
univariate_fix.reason: this avoids giving each feature row equal weight after pre-aggregated per-feature metrics have already rounded or weighted samples differently
